findings.current: A terrifying ring of fire traced its arc, and more than ten enemies caught within its range were swept up in it.
findings.defect: “Its range” reads as the fire’s range, rather than the spell’s. This obscures Jin’s reason for killing those enemies before the body-strengthening magic takes effect.
findings.rationale: 마법의 범위 specifies the magic’s range; the preceding sentence establishes that its targets must be alive for it to work.
findings.replacement: The terrifying ring of fire swept through a dozen or so enemies within the spell’s range.
findings.source: 그 무시무시한 불의 고리가 그리는 궤적에는, 마법의 범위에 포함되어 있던 십여 명의 적들이 있었다.

findings.defect: The invocation reads as an address to the character Taishan rather than a call upon a mountain.
findings.rationale: The spell brings down immense pressure, and Jin subsequently cuts through the invoked 태산.

findings.defect: This makes the spearhead appear to cut through the character Taishan.
findings.rationale: 태산 here refers back to the mountain invoked by the spell, not the named character.
findings.replacement: It cut through the great mountain.

findings.current: And no matter how long an *imugi* lived, without a dragon pearl it couldn’t ascend to the heavens.
findings.defect: “No matter how long” omits the explicit thousand-year age.
findings.rationale: 천년 묵은 specifies an imugi that has lived for a thousand years.
findings.replacement: And even a thousand-year-old *imugi* couldn’t ascend to the heavens without a dragon pearl.
findings.source: 천년 묵은 이무기라 한들 여의주 없이는 하늘로 올라갈 수 없는 것처럼.

findings.current:
> **System**
> - You defeated **[Lv.175 So Gunak]**!
> - Level Up!
findings.defect: The System notice retains square brackets and adds bold emphasis absent from the message.
findings.rationale: The binding panel format identifies System text without square brackets or outer emphasis.
findings.replacement:
> **System**
> - You defeated Lv. 175 So Gunak!
> - Level Up!

findings.current:
> **System**
> - **[Fire Dragon Armor]** has suffered severe damage from powerful energy!
> - **[Fire Dragon Armor]** has been automatically recalled to **[Inventory]**! It cannot be resummoned until the damaged sections are repaired to a certain degree!
> - Time until **[Fire Dragon Armor]** is automatically repaired: **3 days**
findings.defect: The System notices retain square brackets and bold entire UI terms and the time value without a corresponding label or emphasis.
findings.rationale: The binding panel format calls for unbracketed UI terms and no blanket bolding of notice content.
findings.replacement:
> **System**
> - Fire Dragon Armor has suffered severe damage from powerful energy!
> - Fire Dragon Armor has been automatically recalled to Inventory! It cannot be resummoned until the damaged sections are repaired to a certain degree!
> - Time until Fire Dragon Armor is automatically repaired: 3 days

summary: The draft obscures why Jin attacks the mages’ targets, renders a mountain invocation like the name of a person, and misformats both System panels.
